# Mado

> Mado is a free, local design library for brand designers. Collect images, videos, websites and notes, sort them into collections and folders, and keep it all on your own device. No sign-up needed.

Mado runs in the web browser. Your files stay on your device and are never uploaded.

## What you can do

- Save images, videos, websites and notes. Drop, paste or drag them in.
- Sort saves into collections, and folders inside them. Drag a card to move it.
- Search your library by name.
- Export the whole library as a zip, and import it back on any device.

## FAQ

- **Is Mado free?** Yes. The library is free and stays free. Later, cloud and AI extras may be paid, because they cost money each time you use them.
- **Where are my files?** In your browser, on your device. Nothing is uploaded.
- **Can I use it on more than one device?** Not yet. Cloud backup and sync are coming. For now, export your library on one device and import it on the other.
- **What can I save?** Images, videos, websites and notes. Fonts and PDFs come later.
- **What happens if I clear my browser data?** Your library is deleted with it. Export a backup from time to time.
- **Do I need an account?** No. An account is optional, and only needed for cloud features later.
